title: Blackbeard Hypersonic Missile Seen Flying On F/A-18 Super Hornet For The First Time
summary: The Blackbeard hypersonic missile has been observed flying on an F/A-18 Super Hornet for the first time. This marks a significant step in its development and integration. The U.S. Navy aims to bring this lower-cost, rapidly producible standoff weapon into operational service by 2028.

title: Ukraine’s deadly AI training platform for drone tech opens to UK companies
summary: Ukraine has opened its AI training platform, Avengers AI Labs, to British companies. This initiative grants UK firms access to wartime battlefield data. The purpose is to accelerate the development of AI-powered drone technology, leveraging real-world combat insights.

title: Laser Weapons Will Be Deployed At Cape Canaveral Spaceport To Take Down Drones
summary: Laser weapons are slated for deployment at Cape Canaveral Spaceport. Their primary role will be to counter drone threats, enhancing security for critical launch operations and expensive national security payloads. This move aims to protect the spaceport from potential disruptions or attacks by unmanned aerial systems.

title: AI Agents Are Racing to Make Quantum-Safe Bitcoin Cheap—And Winning
summary: An open competition, organized by StarkWare, Yukon Research, and Eigen Labs, has significantly reduced the estimated cost of creating a quantum-safe Bitcoin transaction. AI models led the effort, driving the cost down from approximately $320 to about $67. This represents a substantial advancement in making Bitcoin more resilient to future quantum computing threats.

title: Google Just Made Free 1080p AI Video Generation Available to Anyone
summary: Google Vids now offers free 1080p AI video generation to all Google account holders. The service, powered by Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash, includes new controls for scenes, timing, and watermarks, making advanced AI video creation widely accessible.

title: Bitcoin could soon get Zcash-style 'shielded' privacy without changing its rules
source: CoinDesk: Bitcoin, Ethereum, Crypto News and Price Data
summary: New developments suggest that Bitcoin may soon achieve Zcash-style "shielded" privacy features without requiring changes to its core protocol. This innovation would enhance transaction anonymity for Bitcoin users.

title: Solana’s 150-millisecond settlement upgrade reaches second public test network
source: CoinDesk: Bitcoin, Ethereum, Crypto News and Price Data
summary: Solana's proposed upgrade to achieve 150-millisecond settlement times has advanced to its second public test network. This development marks a key step towards significantly faster transaction finality on the Solana blockchain.

title: Kalshi loses appeal, setting up potential Supreme Court case
summary: The 6th US Circuit Court of Appeals has ruled against prediction market Kalshi, upholding the right of Ohio and Tennessee to regulate sports-event contracts under state laws. This decision could potentially lead to a Supreme Court challenge regarding the regulatory oversight of such markets.

title: US bond sell-off pushes long-term yields to highest since 2004
summary: A significant sell-off in U.S. bonds has driven long-term yields to their highest levels since 2004. Investors are reportedly hesitant to hold risk, contributing to market volatility and making this the worst week for the market since 2024.
